[[Noida]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], India | industry = [[Industrial gases]] | revenue = {{up}} {{INRconvert|5775|c}} (FY23) | net_income = {{up}} {{INRconvert|1328|c}} (FY23){{cite news |title=Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd Q4FY23 consolidated PAT up at Rs. 331.88 crores |url=https://www.equitybulls.com/category.php?id=331103 |access-date=8 July 2023 |work=EquityBulls |date=5 May 2023}} | website = {{URL|https://www.gfl.co.in}} }} '''Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited''' ('''GFL''') is an industrial refrigerant manufacturer under '''INOXGFL Group''' in [[India]]. It is one of the largest producers (by volume) of [[chloromethane]], [[refrigerant]]s and [[polytetrafluoroethylene]] (PTFE).{{cite web|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-leader-speak/deepak-asher-director-group-head-corporate-finance-gujarat-fluorochemicals-115103100049_1.html|title=Deepak Asher, Director & Group Head (Corporate Finance), Gujarat Fluorochemicals|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=2016-09-21}} == History == The company was incorporated in 1987, is a subsidiary of Inox Leasing and Finance Limited. GFL has two manufacturing facilities in [[Gujarat]], a refrigerant plant at Ranjitnagar near Ghoghmba town Panchmahal, and a PTFE facility at Dahej.{{cite web|url=http://www.gfl.co.in/aboutus.php|title=About Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited}}{{cite web|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/company/gujarat-fluorochemicals-ltd/1128|title=Gujarat fluorochemicals ltd Stock/Share Price, Live BSE/NSE Gujarat fluorochemicals ltd Price, Gujarat fluorochemicals ltd Financial News at www.Indiainfoline.com}} It has two subsidiaries - Gujarat Fluorochemicals Americas LLC and Gujarat Fluorochemicals GmbH to cater Americana and European operations respectively.{{fact|date=November 2024}} == Controversies == In 2000s, the company was embroiled in "shoddy practice" of destroying [[HFC 23]], a byproduct released in the coolant-making process at its plant at Nathkuva village in [[Halol]]. In return, company was earning "lucrative" [[carbon credit]].{{Cite news|last=Rosenthal|first=Elisabeth|date=2012-08-08|title=In a Factory's Shadow, Fears About Health|language=en-US|work=The New York Times|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2012/08/09/world/asia/indian-village-at-odds-with-gujarat-fluorochemicals-plant.html|access-date=2021-12-18|issn=0362-4331}} As per the 2010 [[Hindustan Times]] reporting, the company earned nearly half of its revenue for FY 2009-2010 from the sale of carbon credits.{{cite web|date=2010-09-01|title=Carbon credit scam slur on Indian firms|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/delhi/carbon-credit-scam-slur-on-indian-firms/story-sDsMX3X35hFbTZjfTXXLTO.html|access-date=2021-12-18|website=Hindustan Times|language=en}} == Accidents == * On 16 December 2021, 7 people died and 23 others were injured in a blast that took place at GFL's refrigerant manufacturing plant in Ranjitnagar village, Ghoghamba taluka of [[Panchmahal district]].{{cite web|agency=ANI|date=18 Dec 2021|title=Death toll rises to 7 in chemical factory blast in Gujarat's Panchmahal district {{!}} Ahmedabad News - Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/death-toll-rises-to-7-in-chemical-factory-blast-in-gujarats-panchmahal-district/articleshow/88358230.cms|access-date=2021-12-18|website=The Times of India|language=en}}{{Cite news|last=ANI|date=2021-12-18|title=7 dead, 23 injured in a chemical factory blast in Gujarat's Panchmahal|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/7-dead-23-injured-in-a-chemical-factory-blast-in-gujarat-s-panchmahal-121121800099_1.html|access-date=2021-12-18}}{{cite web|date=2021-12-17|title=Gujarat: Explosion at chemical factory leaves 5 dead, 15 injured|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/baroda/gujarat-explosion-at-factory-kills-5-7676838/|access-date=2021-12-18|website=The Indian Express|language=en}} == References == {{reflist}} {{Authority control}} == External links == * {{Official website|https://www.gfl.co.in}} [[Category:Industrial gas companies|Sortkey]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1987]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1987|Sortkey]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Noida|Sortkey]] [[Category:Indian company stubs|Sortkey]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Inox Group]] [[Category:1987 establishments in Uttar Pradesh]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
extract: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited (GFL) is an industrial refrigerant manufacturer under INOXGFL Group in India. It is one of the largest producers (by volume) of chloromethane, refrigerants and polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE).
